# Paracord — Full API Reference

> A TypeScript/Node.js toolkit for building scalable Discord bots with REST, Gateway, and optional gRPC-based remote services for rate limits and requests.

Version: 0.0.5 | License: Apache-2.0 | Node: >=16 | Module: CommonJS

---

## Installation

```
npm install paracord
```

Optional dependencies:
- `pm2` — required for ShardLauncher
- `bufferutil`, `utf-8-validate` — WebSocket performance
- `@grpc/grpc-js`, `@grpc/proto-loader` — required for RPC services (bundled)

---

## Exports

```js
const Paracord = require('paracord');          // default export
const { Paracord, Api, Gateway, ShardLauncher, Server } = require('paracord');
```

All types are available from `paracord` as named exports:
```ts
import type { ApiOptions, RequestOptions, ApiResponse, GatewayOptions, IdentityOptions,
  ParacordOptions, ParacordLoginOptions, ShardLauncherOptions, ServiceOptions,
  RpcServerOptions, GatewayCloseEvent, ParacordStartupEvent } from 'paracord';
```

Discord payload types come from: `discord-api-types/v10`

---

## Class: Api

REST client with built-in rate limit handling, bucket tracking, and optional gRPC delegation.

### Constructor

```ts
new Api(token: string, options?: ApiOptions)
```

- `token` — Discord bot token. Automatically prefixed with `Bot ` if missing.
- `options.emitter` — EventEmitter for debug events.
- `options.requestOptions` — Default RequestOptions applied to all requests.
- `options.queueLoopInterval` — Interval in ms between queue processing cycles. Controls how often rate-limited requests are retried.
- `options.maxConcurrency` — Max number of concurrent in-flight requests. Requests exceeding this are queued.

### Methods

#### `api.request<T>(method: Method, url: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<ApiResponse<T> | RemoteApiResponse<T>>`

Makes a request to Discord, handling rate limits and returning when a non-429 response is received.

- `method` — HTTP method: `'GET'`, `'POST'`, `'PUT'`, `'PATCH'`, `'DELETE'`
- `url` — Discord endpoint path (e.g. `'/channels/123456789'`). Leading slash optional.
- `options` — Per-request overrides (merged with default `requestOptions`).

Returns `ApiResponse<T>` with `{ status, statusText, data: T, headers }`.

#### `api.addRateLimitService(options?: ServiceOptions): Promise<boolean>`

Connects to a remote gRPC rate limit server. The server authorizes each request before it's made.

#### `api.addRequestService(options?: ServiceOptions): Promise<boolean>`

Connects to a remote gRPC request server. The server makes Discord requests on behalf of this client.

Only one RPC service (rate limit OR request) may be added per Api instance.

#### `api.setToken(token: string): void`

Updates the token and recreates the internal HTTP client.

#### `api.end(): void`

Shuts down the request queue and rate limit cache.

#### `Api.extractBucketHashKey(method: string, url: string): string[]`

Static. Derives rate limit bucket key from method + URL path.

#### `Api.isApiDebugEvent(event: unknown): event is ApiDebugEvent`

Static. Type guard for ApiDebugEvent discriminated by source.

### Events

Listen via `api.on(codeName, handler)`:
- `'GENERAL'` — General info log
- `'ERROR'` — Error occurred
- `'REQUEST_SENT'` — Request dispatched (data: `{ request }`)
- `'REQUEST_QUEUED'` — Request queued for rate limit (data: `{ request, reason }`)
- `'REQUEST_REQUEUED'` — Queued request re-sent (data: `{ request, reason }`)
- `'RESPONSE_RECEIVED'` — Response received (data: `{ request, response }`)
- `'RATE_LIMITED'` — Rate limited (data: `{ request, headers, queued }`)
- `'SERVER_ERROR'` — Server error received

---

## Interface: RequestOptions

Per-request configuration for `api.request()`.

```ts
interface RequestOptions {
  data?: unknown;                        // Body payload
  headers?: Record<string, unknown>;     // Additional headers
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;      // URL query parameters
  createForm?: RequestFormDataFunction;   // Form data generator (overrides data/headers)
  local?: boolean;                       // Force local execution, bypass RPC
  returnOnRateLimit?: boolean;           // Don't retry on bucket 429
  returnOnGlobalRateLimit?: boolean;     // Don't retry on global 429
  globalRateLimitMax?: number;           // Known global rate limit cap (default: 50)
  globalRateLimitResetPadding?: number;  // Extra ms on global reset timer (default: 50)
  version?: number;                      // Discord API version (default: 10)
  maxRateLimitRetry?: number;            // Max retries before returning 429 locally
  validateStatus?: null | ((status: number) => boolean);  // Custom status validation
}
```

---

## Interface: ApiResponse\<T\>

```ts
interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  status: number;                    // HTTP status code
  statusText: string;                // Status message (e.g. "OK")
  data: T;                          // Response body from Discord
  headers: Record<string, unknown>;  // Response headers
  retry_after?: number;              // Rate limit retry delay in ms
}
```

---

## Class: Gateway

Manages a single Discord WebSocket gateway connection with heartbeat, identify, and resume logic.

### Constructor

```ts
new Gateway(token: string, options: GatewayOptions)
```

- `token` — Discord bot token. Automatically prefixed with `Bot ` if missing.
- `options` — Required gateway configuration including identity and emitter.

### Properties

- `gateway.id: number` — Shard ID (0 if not sharding).
- `gateway.shard: [number, number] | undefined` — `[shardId, shardCount]` or undefined.
- `gateway.connected: boolean` — Whether the WebSocket is open.
- `gateway.resumable: boolean` — Whether the session can be resumed.
- `gateway.resuming: boolean` — Whether currently resuming a session.
- `gateway.compression: boolean` — Whether compression is enabled.

### Methods

#### `gateway.login(): void`

Opens a WebSocket connection to Discord and begins the identify/resume flow.

#### `gateway.close(code?: GatewayCloseCode, flushWait?: number): void`

Closes the WebSocket connection. Default code: `USER_TERMINATE_RECONNECT` (4997).

#### `gateway.requestGuildMembers(options: GatewayRequestGuildMembersData): boolean`

Sends a Request Guild Members payload. Returns `true` if sent successfully.

#### `gateway.updatePresence(presence: GatewayPresenceUpdateData): boolean`

Updates the bot's presence. Returns `true` if sent successfully.

#### `gateway.setToken(token: string): void`

Updates the token for future identify payloads.

#### `gateway.setCompression(compress: boolean): void`

Enables or disables payload compression.

---

## Interface: GatewayOptions

```ts
interface GatewayOptions {
  identity: IdentityOptions;               // Identify payload structure
  emitter: EventHandler;                   // Event emitter with handleEvent method
  wsUrl: string;                           // WebSocket URL to connect to
  wsParams: GatewayURLQuery;               // WebSocket URL query parameters
  heartbeatIntervalOffset?: number;        // Seconds subtracted from heartbeat interval
  heartbeatTimeoutSeconds?: number;        // Seconds before heartbeat ack timeout
  checkSiblingHeartbeats?: Function[];     // Cross-shard heartbeat checks (internal sharding)
  version?: number;                        // Gateway version (default: 10)
}
```

---

## Interface: IdentityOptions

```ts
interface IdentityOptions {
  intents: number;                                 // Required. Gateway Intents bitfield
  token?: string;                                  // Auth token (set automatically)
  shard?: [number, number];                        // [shardId, shardCount]
  properties?: GatewayIdentifyProperties;          // Client properties
  compress?: boolean;                              // Payload compression (default: false)
  largeThreshold?: number;                         // Large guild threshold (50-250, default: 50)
  presence?: GatewayPresenceUpdateData;            // Initial presence
  guildSubscriptions?: boolean;                    // Typing/presence events (default: true)
}
```

---

## Class: Paracord (extends EventEmitter)

Orchestrates multiple Gateway clients with serialized login queue, startup tracking, and automatic reconnection.

### Constructor

```ts
new Paracord(token: string, options: ParacordOptions)
```

- `token` — Discord bot token. Automatically prefixed with `Bot ` if missing.
- `options` — Required configuration including gateway options.

### Properties

- `paracord.shards: Map<number, Gateway>` — Active gateway clients keyed by shard ID.
- `paracord.connecting: boolean` — Whether gateways are currently starting up.
- `paracord.gatewayLoginQueue: Gateway[]` — Gateways waiting to log in.

### Methods

#### `paracord.login(options?: Partial<ParacordLoginOptions>): Promise<void>`

Connects to Discord's gateway. Spawns gateways for each shard and begins the login queue.

When launched via `ShardLauncher`, shard info is injected via `PARACORD_SHARD_IDS` and `PARACORD_SHARD_COUNT` env vars.

#### `paracord.end(): void`

Terminates all gateways and stops the login interval.

#### `paracord.setToken(token: string): void`

Updates the token on all gateways.

### Events

```ts
paracord.on('READY', (data, shard) => { });
paracord.on('GUILD_CREATE', (data, shard) => { });
paracord.on('MESSAGE_CREATE', (data, shard) => { });
// ... all GatewayDispatchEvents from discord-api-types/v10

paracord.on('GATEWAY_CLOSE', (event: GatewayCloseEvent) => { });
paracord.on('SHARD_STARTUP_COMPLETE', (event: ParacordStartupEvent) => { });
paracord.on('PARACORD_STARTUP_COMPLETE', () => { });
paracord.on('DEBUG', (event) => { });
```

---

## Interface: ParacordOptions

```ts
interface ParacordOptions {
  gatewayOptions: ParacordGatewayOptions;  // Gateway config (without emitter/identity)
  unavailableGuildTolerance?: number;      // Max unavailable guilds before forcing ready
  unavailableGuildWait?: number;           // Seconds since last GUILD_CREATE before forcing ready
  shardStartupTimeout?: number;            // Seconds before timing out a shard's startup
  compressShards?: number[];               // Shard IDs to enable compression on
}
```

---

## Interface: ParacordLoginOptions

```ts
interface ParacordLoginOptions {
  identity: IdentityOptions;                                  // Identify payload
  shards?: number[];                                          // Shard IDs to spawn
  shardCount?: number;                                        // Total shard count
  allowConnection?: (gw: Gateway) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;  // Gate shard connections
}
```

---

## Event Types

```ts
type GatewayCloseEvent = {
  shouldReconnect: boolean;  // Whether the client will attempt reconnection
  code: number;              // WebSocket close code
  gateway: Gateway;          // The gateway that closed
}

type ParacordStartupEvent = {
  shard: Gateway;    // The gateway that completed startup
  forced?: boolean;  // Whether startup was forced due to unavailable guild tolerance
  resumed?: boolean; // Whether the shard resumed rather than fresh-identifying
}

type GatewayHeartbeatSentEvent = {
  scheduleDiff: number;  // Difference between scheduled and actual heartbeat time
  gateway: Gateway;
}

type GatewayHeartbeatAckEvent = {
  latency: number;   // Round-trip latency in ms
  gateway: Gateway;
}
```

---

## Class: ShardLauncher

Spawns shards into pm2 processes, injecting shard information via environment variables.

### Constructor

```ts
new ShardLauncher(main: string, options: ShardLauncherOptions)
```

- `main` — Relative path to the app's entry file.
- `options` — Shard configuration.

### Methods

#### `launcher.launch(pm2Options?: pm2.StartOptions): Promise<void>`

Connects to pm2 and spawns processes. Each chunk of shards gets its own pm2 process.

### Interface: ShardLauncherOptions

```ts
interface ShardLauncherOptions {
  token?: string;                      // Discord token (used to get recommended shard count)
  shardIds?: number[];                 // Shard IDs to spawn (ignored if shardChunks defined)
  shardChunks?: number[][];            // Groups of shard IDs — each group gets its own process
  shardCount?: number;                 // Total number of shards across all instances
  appName?: string;                    // Name shown in pm2 (default: "Discord Bot")
  env?: Record<string, unknown>;       // Additional environment variables
}
```

Environment variables injected by ShardLauncher:
- `PARACORD_TOKEN` — Bot token
- `PARACORD_SHARD_COUNT` — Total shard count
- `PARACORD_SHARD_IDS` — Comma-separated shard IDs for that process

---

## Class: Server (RpcServer, extends grpc.Server)

gRPC server for centralizing rate limit tracking and/or proxying Discord REST requests.

### Constructor

```ts
new Server(options?: RpcServerOptions)
```

### Interface: RpcServerOptions

```ts
interface RpcServerOptions {
  host?: string;                         // Bind host (default: '127.0.0.1')
  port?: string | number;               // Bind port (default: '50051')
  channel?: ServerCredentials;           // gRPC server credentials (default: insecure)
  emitter?: EventEmitter;               // Event emitter for debug logging
  apiClient?: Api;                       // Pre-configured Api client (for request service)
  globalRateLimitMax?: number;           // Global rate limit cap (default: 50)
  globalRateLimitResetPadding?: number;  // Extra ms on global reset timer (default: 50)
}
```

### Methods

#### `server.addRateLimitService(): void`

Adds the rate limit authorization service. Clients check with this server before making Discord requests.

#### `server.addRequestService(token: string, apiOptions?: ApiOptions): void`

Adds the request proxy service. The server makes Discord API requests on behalf of clients.

#### `server.serve(): void`

Starts listening for gRPC connections.

---

## Interface: ServiceOptions (Client-side RPC)

```ts
interface ServiceOptions {
  host?: string;               // RPC server host (default: '127.0.0.1')
  port?: string | number;      // RPC server port (default: '50051')
  channel?: ChannelCredentials; // gRPC channel credentials
  allowFallback?: boolean;     // Fall back to local handling if RPC unavailable (default: true)
}
```

---

## Utility Functions

### `coerceTokenToBotLike(token: string): string`
Prefixes token with `Bot ` if not already present.

### `timestampFromSnowflake(snowflake: Snowflake): number`
Extracts a Unix timestamp from a Discord snowflake ID.

### `computeChannelPerms({ member, guild, channel, stopOnOwnerAdmin? }): bigint`
Computes a member's effective permissions for a specific channel, including role and member overwrites.

### `computeGuildPerms({ member, guild, stopOnOwnerAdmin? }): bigint`
Computes a member's guild-level permissions from their roles.

### `constructUserAvatarUrl(user, options?): string`
Generates the Discord CDN URL for a user's avatar.

### `constructGuildIcon(guild, fileType?): string | undefined`
Generates the Discord CDN URL for a guild's icon. Returns undefined if no icon.

### `clone<T>(object: T): T`
Deep clones an object via JSON serialization.

### `isApiError(val: unknown): val is ApiError`
Type guard for error objects produced by failed API requests.

---

## Constants

```ts
DISCORD_API_URL = 'https://discord.com/api'
DISCORD_API_DEFAULT_VERSION = 10
DISCORD_CDN_URL = 'https://cdn.discordapp.com'
DISCORD_EPOCH = 1420070400000   // 2015-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

GATEWAY_MAX_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE = 120
GATEWAY_REQUEST_BUFFER = 4
DEFAULT_GATEWAY_BOT_WAIT = 5000  // ms
DISCORD_WS_VERSION = 10

API_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT = 50
API_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_RESET_MILLISECONDS = 1000
API_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_RESET_PADDING_MILLISECONDS = 50
API_RATE_LIMIT_EXPIRE_AFTER_MILLISECONDS = 300000  // 5 minutes

GATEWAY_OP_CODES   // { DISPATCH: 0, HEARTBEAT: 1, IDENTIFY: 2, ... }
GATEWAY_CLOSE_CODES // { CLEAN: 1000, AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: 4004, ... }
LOG_SOURCES         // { GATEWAY: 0, API: 1, PARACORD: 2, RPC: 3 }
LOG_LEVELS          // { FATAL: 0, ERROR: 1, WARNING: 2, INFO: 4, DEBUG: 5 }
API_DEBUG_CODES     // { GENERAL: 1, ERROR: 2, REQUEST_SENT: 3, ... }
```

---

## Architecture Notes

- Gateway → emits Discord events to a provided emitter's `handleEvent(type, data, gateway)` method.
- Paracord → orchestrates many Gateways, serializes logins via a queue, tracks startup progress.
- Api → wraps axios with `RateLimitCache`; queues requests when bucket/global limits hit; retries 5xx up to 3 times.
- Server (RpcServer) → centralizes rate limit state for multi-process deployments; can also proxy REST requests.
- ShardLauncher → spawns pm2 processes; injects `PARACORD_TOKEN`, `PARACORD_SHARD_COUNT`, `PARACORD_SHARD_IDS` env vars.
- Tokens are always coerced to `Bot <token>` format via `coerceTokenToBotLike()`.
- All clients emit `DEBUG` events tagged with `LOG_SOURCES` for structured observability.
